data.title: 山田杏奈 · 拍摄休息室大号卫衣的大长腿瘫坐·「拍摄好累哦……市川，给我吃一口软糖嘛」
data.description: 摄影工作结束，杏奈换上宽松连帽卫衣和牛仔短裤，坐进休息室的皮沙发里。她把扎发的发圈取下放在靠垫旁，黑发散到肩上；看到你拿出软糖，立刻抬起头，从宽袖口里伸出一根手指指向糖袋，疲惫的脸也跟着亮了起来。
data.location: 摄影棚后台休息区皮沙发
data.action: 散发坐在摄影休息室沙发上，抬头望向软糖袋，伸手指示自己也想尝一颗。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, action and face visible
data.mood: 大型犬撒娇、惊人大长腿
data.promptProse: After the photo session, Anna Yamada sits deep in the dressing-room leather sofa, hair tie removed and long black hair loose over her charcoal hoodie. She perks up at her companion's gummy-candy bag, pointing toward it from a broad sleeve. The medium view includes her denim shorts, cushion and discarded hair tie. Warm mirror lamps brighten her refreshed expression and sleeve edge, with softer reflections on the sofa's worn leather.
